**_This is just a placeholder generated by AI. It's not a real blog post._**

Constraints are often seen as obstacles to creativity, but I've found the opposite to be true. Some of my best work has emerged from severe limitations—whether technical, aesthetic, or conceptual.

When you have infinite possibilities, decision paralysis sets in. But give yourself three colors instead of thousands, or commit to a specific grid system, and suddenly the path forward becomes clearer. Constraints force you to be more creative, not less.
